samePPP: Equivalent at the same purchasing power
distributionNote: Bars use a linear income scale. Exact values are listed below. These are percentile thresholds, not population counts.
rankLink: See where this annual income ranks
grossNote: Gross pay before tax. Hours and weeks are assumptions, not a tax or overtime calculation.
pppNote: PPP compares national price levels, not current exchange rates, city rents or your personal living costs.
rankNote: WID pre-tax national income is broader than salary. These are adult income ranks, not employee salary percentiles.
invalid: Check the numbers and ranges shown beside each input.
medianQ: What is the median income in {name}?
top10Q: What is the top 10% income in {name}?
medianWorld: Worldwide rank of the country median
publishedNote: Published in the imported WID series. Annual pre-tax national income, not net salary.
missingCoverage: Germany and mainland China are not included in this imported dataset. Other sources may cover them.
handoffNote: Enter an annual amount in the main calculator; the link keeps the country, not your income.
rangePolicy: Targets between published points are interpolated. Targets outside the published range are extrapolated and more uncertain.
